Ashoka Buildcon wins contracts in India and Bhutan

Ashoka Buildcon's shares saw a significant increase, jumping nearly 14% on the stock market following the announcement of two project wins. The company secured a solar power project in Bhutan valued at $58.9 million. Additionally, it received a Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for a project with an accepted Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) price of Rs 865.90 crore, excluding GST.
